create_knowledgesource_mongo: create a KnowledgeSource instance connected to a MongoDB database for querying Wikipedia pages
get_page_by_id: get a Wikipedia page document from the MongoDB collection by its Wikipedia page ID
get_page_by_title: get a Wikipedia page document from the MongoDB collection by its page title string
get_page_from_url: get a Wikipedia page document by parsing a Wikipedia URL and looking up the page
get_all_pages_cursor: get a MongoDB cursor to iterate over all Wikipedia page documents in the collection
